views.name: cleaned_weekly_sales_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  week_date_formatted AS week_date_formatted,
  week_date AS week_date,
  region AS region,
  platform AS platform,
  segment AS segment,
  customer_type AS customer_type,
  transactions AS transactions,
  sales AS sales,
  week_number AS week_number,
  month_number AS month_number,
  calendar_year AS calendar_year,
  age_band AS age_band,
  demographic AS demographic,
  avg_transaction AS avg_transaction
FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
views.description: Canonical projection of cleaned_weekly_sales with typed/renamed derived metrics exposed. Use this as the normalized weekly sales grain with consistent date/year/month fields and common measures for downstream joins and aggregations. | Use for: Time series of sales or transactions by region/platform/segment/customer_type; Comparisons of avg_transaction across demographics or segments; Monthly/weekly aggregates and trend analysis

views.name: weekly_sales_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  week_date AS week_date,
  region AS region,
  platform AS platform,
  segment AS segment,
  customer_type AS customer_type,
  transactions AS transactions,
  sales AS sales
FROM weekly_sales
views.description: Canonical projection of weekly_sales fact table exposing core attributes and measures for aggregations or joins. Use when cleaned_weekly_sales is not available or to compare raw weekly_sales with cleaned data. | Use for: Raw weekly sales and transaction volume queries; Comparing raw vs cleaned weekly sales; Aggregations by region/platform/segment over time

views.name: bitcoin_transactions_enriched
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  b.txn_id AS txn_id,
  b.member_id AS member_id,
  m.first_name AS first_name,
  m.region AS region,
  b.ticker AS ticker,
  b.txn_date AS txn_date,
  b.txn_type AS txn_type,
  b.quantity AS quantity,
  b.percentage_fee AS percentage_fee,
  b.txn_time AS txn_time
FROM bitcoin_transactions b
LEFT JOIN bitcoin_members m
  ON b.member_id = m.member_id
views.description: Join of bitcoin_transactions to bitcoin_members to provide member attributes (first_name, region) alongside each transaction. Useful for member-level aggregations, segmentation, and regional analyses of crypto activity. | Use for: Member-level transaction summaries; Regional volume or fee analysis by ticker; Join-based filters like transactions for members in a specific region

views.name: shopping_session_events
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  e.visit_id AS visit_id,
  e.cookie_id AS cookie_id,
  e.page_id AS page_id,
  p.page_name AS page_name,
  p.product_category AS product_category,
  p.product_id AS product_id,
  e.event_type AS event_type,
  i.event_name AS event_name,
  e.sequence_number AS sequence_number,
  e.event_time AS event_time
FROM shopping_cart_events e
LEFT JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy p
  ON e.page_id = p.page_id
LEFT JOIN shopping_cart_event_identifier i
  ON e.event_type = i.event_type
views.description: Denormalized view joining shopping_cart_events to page hierarchy and event identifier to provide human-readable page and event names for each visit event. Useful for funnel, path, and event-sequence analyses. | Use for: Session path/funnel analyses (e.g., sequences of page views to add-to-cart); Event counts per page or per campaign when joined to campaign mapping; Time-based session analyses using event_time ordering

views.name: shopping_cookie_user_map
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  user_id AS user_id,
  cookie_id AS cookie_id,
  start_date AS start_date
FROM shopping_cart_users
views.description: Mapping of shopping_cart_users to their latest known start_date per cookie_id. Useful for deduplicating cookie-level identities and joining session-level events to user records. | Use for: Attributing sessions to users via cookie_id; Cohorts based on user start_date; Linking shopping behavior to user-level attributes

views.name: veg_txn_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  "index" AS "index",
  txn_date AS txn_date,
  txn_time AS txn_time,
  item_code AS item_code,
  "qty_sold(kg)" AS "qty_sold(kg)",
  "unit_selling_px_rmb/kg" AS "unit_selling_px_rmb/kg",
  "sale/return" AS "sale/return",
  "discount(%)" AS "discount(%)",
  day_of_week AS day_of_week
FROM veg_txn_df
views.description: Normalized projection of veg_txn_df with core measures and attributes available for aggregation. Preserves original column names including unusual ones so downstream queries can reference them directly. | Use for: Total quantity sold or revenue per item over a period; Price/discount analyses and weekday patterns; Joining to veg_cat or veg_whsle_df for enriched item attributes

views.name: veg_item_master
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.item_code AS item_code,
  c.item_name AS item_name,
  c.category_code AS category_code,
  c.category_name AS category_name,
  l."loss_rate_%" AS "loss_rate_%"
FROM veg_cat c
LEFT JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l
  ON c.item_code = l.item_code
views.description: Vegetable item master combining category and loss rate metadata so item-level analyses can reference category_name and loss_rate_% alongside transactions. | Use for: Item-level margin or loss analyses; Category-level rollups and comparisons; Joining transaction facts to item metadata

views.name: bitcoin_prices_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ticker AS ticker,
  market_date AS market_date,
  price AS price,
  open AS open,
  high AS high,
  low AS low,
  volume AS volume,
  change AS change
FROM bitcoin_prices
views.description: Canonical projection of bitcoin_prices for time series price analysis. Keeps raw price/open/high/low/volume/change columns for financial measures. | Use for: Price time series and volatility calculations; Merging prices to transaction timestamps for P&L; Aggregations like daily/weekly average price per ticker

views.name: interest_metrics_monthly
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  interest_id AS interest_id,
  month_year AS month_year,
  _month AS _month,
  _year AS _year,
  composition AS composition,
  index_value AS index_value,
  ranking AS ranking,
  percentile_ranking AS percentile_ranking
FROM interest_metrics
views.description: Monthly-level metrics per interest_id preserving composition, index and percentile/ranking. Useful to aggregate or rank interests across months or compute trends. | Use for: Trend analysis of composition or index_value per interest over time; Selecting top-ranked interests per month using ranking or percentile_ranking

views.name: customer_transactions_base
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id AS customer_id,
  txn_date AS txn_date,
  txn_type AS txn_type,
  txn_amount AS txn_amount
FROM customer_transactions
views.description: Projection of raw customer_transactions events preserving original columns for customer-level activity and transaction amount analyses. | Use for: Customer lifetime value or total deposits/withdrawals; Time-based cohorts of transaction behavior; Joining to customer_nodes for region/node attribution

views.name: customer_nodes_current
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customer_id AS customer_id,
  region_id AS region_id,
  node_id AS node_id,
  start_date AS start_date,
  end_date AS end_date,
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY start_date DESC) AS start_rank
FROM customer_nodes
views.description: Latest node assignment per customer_id based on the most recent start_date. Exposes a row_number rank so consumers can filter to the single latest assignment or examine histories. | Use for: Attributing current region/node to customer-level events; History of node assignments and detecting overlaps; Filtering to latest node assignment per customer (WHERE start_rank = 1)
